name.en: Salvinia paired floats and submerged leaf

description.en: Freshwater Salvinia-inspired node with exactly two broad floating leaves and one dissected descending submerged leaf. The lower root-like organ is a LEAF, not true roots. No marine label, microscopic leaf-hair or exact species claim.
description.zh: 淡水Salvinia启发叶节，具有两片宽浮叶和一片下垂分叉沉水叶。下方根状器官是叶，不是真根。不作海水植物、微观叶毛或精确种复原。
